purpose: Shared 23-language runtime boundary for UI/API/Internal-AI/TTS. This is a runtime governance layer, not an additional external service gate.
ttsRule: Internal TTS/model coverage is used first. External TTS may be considered only when the requested language/voice has verified provider coverage and both the external service gate and provider slot are explicitly enabled by Master Admin.
aiRule: All managed Internal AIs inherit the same 23-language contract. TTS coverage does not reduce AI language support; TTS capability is independently resolved per language.
memoryRule: Language selection and TTS routing must never promote external output into sealed project/master memory automatically. Memory promotion remains separately gated.
futureLanguageRule: Future languages use the same registry/evidence contract and do not require source-code enum changes.
fallbackRule: Supported non-English values are used when usable; missing, empty, whitespace-only, or explicit [key] values fall back to the authoritative English catalog. Unsupported/unavailable locales fall back to English. The registry is dynamic and future languages do not require a hard-coded enum.
